			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0

				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1
				)

				or (

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 10:38:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 17:23:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with impairment as (
	SELECT business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		name_pp,
		SUM(cptl_el_rsk_contr_cppd) AS cptl_el_rsk_contr_cppd
	FROM risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_rc
	where business_date = (
			select max(business_date)
			FROM risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_rc
		)
		and name_pp IN ('|CPPIB-ALL|ACPP', '|CPPIB-ALL|BCPP')
	GROUP BY business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		name_pp
)
SELECT case
		when name_pp = '|CPPIB-ALL|ACPP' then 'ACPP_ISRC_CREDITVAR_PCT_GT'
		when name_pp = '|CPPIB-ALL|BCPP' then 'BCPP_ISRC_CREDITVAR_PCT_GT'
	end as LIMIT_NAME,
	(rc.cptl_el_rsk_contr_cppd / fact.analytic_value) * 100 as MEASURE_VALUE
FROM impairment rc
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh ON rc.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	and dh.business_date = rc.business_date
	JOIN risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact ON rc.dim_hierarchy_node_id = fact.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	and rc.business_date = fact.business_date
	AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
	AND rc.name_pp IN ('|CPPIB-ALL|ACPP', '|CPPIB-ALL|BCPP')
	and rc.business_date = (
		select max(business_date)

/* cppi::b1c48a0f24c7eac9fc208c33262e312d0943416e1d6761a27eed8a9eb23fad4f */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( SELECT
    COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
    strategy,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) AS pv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS var_10yr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS es_10yr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS vol_10yr,
    -- Derived metrics as percentages of PV
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) 
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END), 0) AS var_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END), 0) AS es_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END), 0) AS vol_pct
FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
  AND hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  AND (
        analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
        OR (
            analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
            AND confidence_level = 0.95
        )
      )
  AND business_date =  '2025-04-22'
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL'),
    strategy ) ds LIMIT 0

/* cppi::e4671ee54a690cc9ceedce0f4ce8d0e5d8e032e6a7757a7c8eb686f5973fbb2d */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 09:18:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df2
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))              AS model_portfolio_id,
           CONCAT('RD', UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(asset_code), 2)))  AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           il_reporting_name                                 AS reporting_name,
           investment_agg_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           investment_count_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           country_region_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           emerging_market_il,
           UPPER(df_status) = 'DRAFT'                        AS is_draft
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
),
latest_yardi_asset_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           asset_count,
           investment_name,
           investment_desc_il                                         AS investment_description,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           investment_type_al,
           investment_stage_current_al,
           market_type,
           reporting_currency_al,
           sector_focus_level_1_al,
           sector_focus_level_2_al,
           funding_bucket_il,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_manager_al
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'AL'
),
il_al_relationship AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(il_asset_code) AS il_asset_code,
           TRIM(al_asset_code) AS al_asset_code
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_relationships
),
latest_yardi_assets AS (
    SELECT rel.al_asset_code                                  AS asset_code,
           ild.asset_code                                     AS investment_code,
           ald.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           Ild.reporting_name,
           ald.al_investment_name,
           ald.investment_name,
           ald.investment_description,
           ald.investment_type_al,
           ald.first_funding_date,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_2,
           ald.investment_stage_current_al,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.is_draft,
           ald.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ald.sector_focus_level_1_al,
           ald.sector_focus_level_2_al,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ald.reporting_currency_al,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ald.investment_manager_al,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN il_al_relationship                    rel  ON rel.il_asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND rel.business_date = ild.business_date AND rel.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_asset_level_details      ald  ON ald.asset_code    = rel.al_asset_code         AND ald.business_date = ild.business_date AND ald.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code    = ald.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ald.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ald.as_of_date
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code    = ald.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ald.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ald.as_of_date
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code    = ald.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ald.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ald.as_of_date

	GROUP BY

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten) AS max_ist_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl) AS max_psl_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite) AS max_secc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_pcc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)
SELECT
    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel3 as investment_structure_level_03,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel4 as investment_structure_level_04 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel5 as investment_structure_level_05 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel6 as investment_structure_level_06 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel7 as investment_structure_level_07 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel8 as investment_structure_level_08 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel9 as investment_structure_level_09 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel10 as investment_structure_level_10 ,
    ist.model_portfolio_name, 
    psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_2 as quoted_currency,
    psl.aggregation_level_3 as scd_security_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_4,
    psl.aggregation_level_5,
    secc.esm_security_name,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency,
    psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency, 
    psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency, 
    psl.market_value_reporting_currency, 
    psl.market_value_quotation_currency,
    coalesce (pcc.epm_party_name, epc.epm_party_name) as issuer,
    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent
FROM 
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
    
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
    ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
    AND ist.business_date = (select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
    AND ist.investmentstructure IN ('CPPIB_F24')
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities scds
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = scds.abor_security_id
    AND scds.business_date = (select max_scds_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
	on scds.abor_issuer_id = spi.party_id
	and spi.business_date = (select max_spi_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite epc
	on epc.party_id = spi.party_id 
	and epc.business_date = (select max_epc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
LEFT JOIN cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = secc.abor_security_id
    AND secc.business_date = (select max_secc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite upcc
	on coalesce (pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id, epc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id) = upcc.enterprise_party_id
	and upcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
WHERE psl.business_date = (SELECT max_psl_bd FROM MaxBusinessDates)

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs

		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 00:01:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	)

where business_date = date'2025-06-23'				
)

left join				
(select

where business_date = date'2025-06-23'				
)				
as c				
on a.id_underlying_instrument = c.cppib_sec_id_new2
left join 
(select trading_portfolio_code, id_model_portfolio 
from finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
where business_date = date'2025-06-23'	
) as d
on a.trading_portfolio = d.trading_portfolio_code
left join 
(select id_model_portfolio, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
where business_date = date'2025-06-23'
) as e
on d.id_model_portfolio = e.id_model_portfolio				
left join
(select
     cppib_party_id,
     party_name,
     domicile_country_code,
     incorp_country_code,
     bloomberg_company_id
from party.party
where business_date = date'2025-06-23'
) as p
on p.cppib_party_id = cast(a.id_counterparty as int)

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 17:26:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

  with ae_temp as (
      select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
             (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   else abacus_pv_base_ccy end
             ) as exposure
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_position"
      where investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and portfolio_type = 'IP' and product_type in ('Common Stock','Common Stock Private','Convertible_bond','Equity Swap','Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index','Unit','Pooled Fund Absolute Return','Listed Warrant','Preferred Stock','REIT','Depository Receipt','Leveraged Loans') and long_short = 'LONG'
  ),
  
  analytics as (
      select business_date, node, analytic_name, analytic_value
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_analytics"
      where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
      and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
      and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
      and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
  )
  
  select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
         (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
  from (
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
  
      union
  
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
  ) as q1
  right join analytics 
  on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
) "custom_sql_query"
LIMIT 0) T LIMIT 0

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 17:56:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
